scope: isolated generated scalar-kernel microbenchmark, excludes preparation and public core; shared frozen opt2 runtime, generated generic kernels opt3/codegen16; NOT original IREGI or release end-to-end parity
measurement_overhead: One Instant start/elapsed pair per fixed loop block; black_box input/output each call; no overhead subtraction; independent 2ms pilots choose shared iteration count targeting30ms mean cost
qualification: 24 f64 configurations before and after timing on exact measured binary; original three-domain qualifications retained separately; f64-only compilation changes code layout relative to original protocol
quiet_window: root coordinated; owned D0 compile SIGSTOP; all other project compute paused
